title: 一起画彩虹

prompts.opening: 画纸准备好了。你想先用哪种颜色？
prompts.ask: 画好了！你会怎么跟朋友说它是什么颜色？
prompts.practice: 我们练一句描述颜色的话。你会怎么说？

prompts_en.opening: Our paper is ready! Which color would you like to use first?
prompts_en.ask: All painted! How would you tell a friend its color in Chinese?
prompts_en.practice: Let's describe a color in Chinese. What would you say?

invitation: 我们一起画条彩虹，好吗？

capabilities.A: Practice short Chinese phrases describing colors: red and blue.
capabilities.B: Draw or paint together through a pretend rainbow/color activity: choose red or blue, then talk about the picture. Supports requests to draw, paint or make art now; no digital drawing canvas.
